text:
maria: FYI staging publish for release=2024.3.1 failed when deploy-bot tried to push manifest to eu-ecr. deploy-bot posted a digest/size error. anyone seen this before?

deploy-bot: publish halted: ECR PutManifest rejected (ManifestValidationException) - layer size mismatch with uploaded blob. manifest: sha256:abcd... size=5283941, blob: size=5242880. created_by=ci/pipeline-6821.

nisarg: ugh, saw similar once when docker build produced `--squash` artifact locally. could be gzip layer size rounded by registry. is this only eu region?

maria: looks regional — staging-us showed success earlier. eu-ecr failed during last chunk finalize. logs: `PUT /v2/redwood/service/manifests/sha256:abcd... 400`

samir: @deploy-bot can you requeue or retry the upload? might have been a transient multipart upload hang.

deploy-bot: automatic retry attempted 2/3. On retry 3: same validation error. Flagging for manual intervention.

nisarg: ok two obvious options: 1) retag the image to a new manifest via CI rebuild (ensures consistent chunking) or 2) pin previous good digest for the canary/promo and skip this eu publish until we investigate. Which do we want during the 2-4pm change window?

release-coordinator: Change window is active now (2:00-4:00). We shouldn't risk a cross-region promo during it. Proposal: pin previous digest for eu and schedule a forced rebuild post-window. update release notes with short note about eu publish delay.

maria: agree. We should avoid pushing a partial manifest that could cause consumers to pull inconsistent layers. pinning previous digest + adding a changelog entry sounds good.

samir: +1. Action items: (a) release-coordinator pin prev digest in release manifest routing, (b) ci-team start a no-cache rebuild job and upload to eu staging with a unique tag, (c) ops to do a manual manifest inspect and check chunk sizes in S3 multipart uploads.

release-coordinator: I'm pinning now. previous digest is sha256:1234abcd... pinned for eu-staging and eu-canary routes. Adding note to release notes: "EU staging publish delayed due to ECR manifest validation; eu traffic pinned to previous verified image."

maria: can you also add an entry to the release-issues board and tag `ecr` and `publish`?

release-coordinator: done. board card created: /board/RELEASES-312 - "ECR eu manifest size mismatch - pin & rebuild". Assigning to @nisarg for triage after window.

nisarg: I will triage post-window. quick thought — if the blob size differs by a small amount (like 40KB), can we just re-upload the blob with correct Content-Length and re-put the manifest? Might be safe but manual and brittle. I'll inspect the multipart parts.

samir: keep me in loop. if rebuild is needed, prefer CI job that changes compression flags so layers deterministically match across regions. add `--no-cache` and explicit gzip step.

maria: thanks all. I'll update internal release slack with pinned status and add a short blurb for customers in the release notes describing the eu publish delay and ETA for rebuild (T+6h). :memo: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: note: since push was halted, no deploys were promoted. No rollback required. automatic alerts suppressed per policy.

release-coordinator: closing thread for now, will reopen if ci rebuild fails.

samir: thx.
